items.mainDefect: isAccessTokenId reads the grant shortcut with substring(3,5) instead of substring(4,6).

secondary.defect: The matcher returns false when the shortcut matches, which inverts the check.

items.mainDefect: getShortcut() is a new abstract SPI method with no default, so existing custom OAuth2GrantTypeFactory implementations break.

secondary.defect: The shortcut length is documented as 'usually 3 letters' and is never validated, but the decoder needs exactly 2 characters.
A null shortcut makes grantsByShortcuts.put throw an NPE in postInit, which breaks server startup.
